description: The class of a is below the class of b in the ordered quotient exactly when a ≤ b.
signature:
toAntisymmetrization_le_toAntisymmetrization_iff.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} {a b : α} [Preorder α] :
  toAntisymmetrization (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) a ≤ toAntisymmetrization (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) b ↔ a ≤ b
